subject: Kickoff: dense entity retrieval for the knowledge assistant
body:
Team,

Kicking off the entity retrieval track. The plan is to take the dense-representations work from our open-source release and make it the linking backbone for the internal knowledge assistant. Concretely: a dual encoder that retrieves entities directly in embedding space, evaluated against the 2018 Wikinews annotations we regenerate with parse_wikinews.py from the Jan 1, 2019 dump.

Milestones I want to socialize: baseline reproduction by May 15, retrieval quality review June 12, and an LRB pre-read the week of July 6. Success metric for the quality review is recall@1 on Wikinews within 2 points of the published numbers.

Ivo, can you come back with staffing and a compute ask this week? OKR language due to Hana by Friday.

Thanks,
Anders
